title: Plain-language detail page
author: claude
summary: Separate sections: one line, what/why/how, before and after, problems, tech cards, related and files.
what: The detail page was rebuilt in separate sections, and the same page opens as a side panel on the board.
why: Part of making the dev log easier to read.
how: Tech cards, red and green problem and fix boxes, clickable related entries, and a collapsed section for files and settings.
